JmapThread.description:
A JMAP Thread object (RFC 8621 §3.1).

A Thread is a set of Email objects that share the same root
`Message-ID` and in-reply-to chain.

emailIds.description: Ordered list of email IDs in this thread, oldest first.

id.description: The server-assigned ID for this thread.

description: Renderable table of threads and their email IDs.
title: ThreadsTable
